articles.title: Google Hikes Price of Budget Pixel 10a Phone to $599 on Memory Costs
articles.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google raised the price of its seven-month-old Pixel 10a smartphone by $100 to $599, another example of how rising memory costs are making even older devices more expensive.

articles.title: Nscale Hires Meta’s Justin Osofsky to Be COO Ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Nscale, the artificial intelligence infrastructure company, hired a long-time Meta Platforms Inc. executive to be its chief operating officer, to accelerate a rapid expansion connected to its upcoming initial public offering, according to a person familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Nvidia Falls Short of May Record as Value Nears $6 Trillion
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp. shares touched an intraday high for the first time since May before trimming those gains and closing just short of a record as investors piled back into the stock after a two-month selloff that wiped out more than $1 trillion of market value.

articles.title: Apple to Tighten Mac Data Controls in Guard Against AI Agents
articles.summary: Apple Inc. said it plans to introduce new privacy controls for Mac users, warning of the growing risks around granting broad data access to third-party software, including artificial intelligence agents.

articles.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T Glitch Requires Device Replacements
articles.summary: Apple Inc. said “a small number” of AT&T Inc. customers who recently upgraded to the company’s iPhone 18 Pro Max will need to replace their devices after a bug caused them to lose cellular service.

articles.title: Hong Kong users caught off guard as Anthropic tightens VPN access to Claude
articles.summary: US artificial intelligence company Anthropic appears to have stepped up enforcement of geographical restrictions on its Claude models in Hong Kong, with local users reporting abrupt account suspensions after accessing the service through virtual private networks (VPNs). A wave of complaints surfaced on social media platforms X and Reddit on Thursday, as users who had operated accounts for months using VPNs found them suddenly disabled. One Hong Kong-based user posted on the “r/claude” subreddit.
